78704-the-bungalow-mystery.title: The Bungalow Mystery
78704-the-bungalow-mystery.creator: Carolyn Keene
78704-the-bungalow-mystery.description: A book by Carolyn Keene. She gave the steering wheel a turn and headed the motorboat toward the eastern shore. Although it was not yet dusk, darkness seemed to be closing in upon the lake. It was with difficulty that the girls distinguished the shore line. The water, which only a few minutes before had been a smooth, clear blue, lashed about the little boat in angry, inky waves.

arxiv-2110-01667.title: Wide field Beamformed Observation with MeerKAT
arxiv-2110-01667.creator: Weiwei Chen 1, Ewan Barr 1, Ramesh Karuppusamy 1, Michael Kramer 1,2, Benjamin Stappers 2
arxiv-2110-01667.description: Abstract Large-scale beamforming with radio interferometers has the potential to revolutionize the science done with pulsars and fast radio bursts by improving the survey efficiency for these sources. We describe a wide-field beamformer for the MeerKAT radio telescope and outline strategies to optimally design such surveys.

arxiv-2210-10389.title: Distributional Adaptive Soft Regression Trees
arxiv-2210-10389.creator: Nikolaus Umlauf Universität Innsbruck, Nadja Klein Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin
arxiv-2210-10389.description: Abstract \Plainauthor Umlauf N., Klein N. \Plaintitle Distributional Adaptive Soft Regression Trees \Shorttitle Distributional Adaptive Soft Regression Trees \Abstract Random forests are an ensemble method relevant for many problems, such as regression or classification. They are popular due to their good predictive performance (compared to, e.g., decision trees) requiring only minimal tuning of hyperparameters.

arxiv-2304-13500.title: Subspace Coding for Error Control and Interference Mitigation in Routing Solutions with Cooperative Destination Nodes
arxiv-2304-13500.creator: Mohamed Amine Brahimi, Fatiha Merazka
arxiv-2304-13500.description: Abstract Random Linear Network Coding (RLNC) is a transmission scheme that opts for linear combinations of the transmitted packets at a subset of the intermediate nodes. This scheme is usually considered when Network Coding (NC) is desired over non-coherent networks. In order to integrate error correction in RLNC, subspace codes have been proposed.

arxiv-2306-11333.title: COMPLETION OF TESTING SERIES DOUBLE-SPOKE CAVITY CRYOMODULES FOR ESS
arxiv-2306-11333.creator: R. Santiago Kern, C. Svanberg, K. Fransson, K. Gajewski, L. Hermansson, H. Li, T. Lofnes, A. Miyazaki, M. Olvegård, I. Profatilova, R. Ruber, M. Zhovner, Uppsala University, Uppsala, Sweden
arxiv-2306-11333.description: Abstract The FREIA Laboratory at Uppsala University, Sweden, has completed the evaluation of 13 double-spoke cavity cryomodules for ESS. This is the first time double-spoke cavities will be deployed in a real machine. This paper summarizes testing procedures and statistics of the results and lessons learned.

arxiv-2308-11498.title: Shape matters: long-range transport of microplastic fibers in the atmosphere
arxiv-2308-11498.creator: Daria Tatsii, Silvia Bucci, Taraprasad Bhowmick, Johannes Guettler, Lucie Bakels, Gholamhossein Bagheri, Andreas Stohl
arxiv-2308-11498.description: Abstract Deposition of giant microplastic particles from the atmosphere has been observed in the most remote places on Earth. However, their deposition patterns are difficult to reproduce using current atmospheric transport models. These models usually treat particles as perfect spheres, whereas the real shapes of microplastic particles are often far from spherical.

arxiv-2407-01406.title: Adapting Multilingual LLMs to Low-Resource Languages with Knowledge Graphs via Adapters
arxiv-2407-01406.creator: Daniil Gurgurov, Mareike Hartmann, Simon Ostermann
arxiv-2407-01406.description: Abstract This paper explores the integration of graph knowledge from linguistic ontologies into multilingual Large Language Models (LLMs) using adapters to improve performance for low-resource languages (LRLs) in sentiment analysis (SA) and named entity recognition (NER). Building upon successful parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, such as K-ADAPTER Wang et al. 2021 and MAD-X Pfeiffer et al.

arxiv-2409-09905.title: Rediscovering the Latent Dimensions of Personality with Large Language Models as Trait Descriptors
arxiv-2409-09905.creator: Joseph Suh * Suhong Moon * Minwoo Kang * David M. Chan
arxiv-2409-09905.description: Abstract Assessing personality traits using large language models (LLMs) has emerged as an interesting and challenging area of research. While previous methods employ explicit questionnaires, often derived from the Big Five model of personality, we hypothesize that LLMs implicitly encode notions of personality when modeling next-token responses.

arxiv-2504-08623.title: Enterprise-Grade Security for the Model Context Protocol (MCP): Frameworks and Mitigation Strategies
arxiv-2504-08623.creator: Vineeth Sai Narajala, Idan Habler
arxiv-2504-08623.description: Abstract The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic, provides a standardized framework for artificial intelligence (AI) systems to interact with external data sources and tools in real-time. While MCP offers significant advantages for AI integration and capability extension, it introduces novel security challenges that demand rigorous analysis and mitigation.

arxiv-2511-10398.title: Spectral rigidity of Liouville tori
arxiv-2511-10398.creator: Joscha Henheik, Vadim Kaloshin, Yunzhe Li, Amir Vig
arxiv-2511-10398.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Joscha Henheik, Vadim Kaloshin, Yunzhe Li, Amir Vig. We show that Laplace isospectral deformations within a conformal class of generic Liouville metrics on the two-dimensional torus that are linear in the deformation parameter are necessarily trivial. Two of the main ingredients in our proof are a noncancellation result for the wave trace and an analysis of the second order variational formula for the energy functional associated to closed geodesics.

arxiv-2601-18310.title: Holographic timelike entanglement and subregion complexity with scalar hair
arxiv-2601-18310.creator: Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi, Muhammad Alifaldi Ramadhan Al-Faritsi, Rafi Rizqy Firdaus, Fitria Khairunnisa, Yanoar Pribadi Sarwono, Freddy Permana Zen
arxiv-2601-18310.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hadyan Luthfan Prihadi, Muhammad Alifaldi Ramadhan Al-Faritsi, Rafi Rizqy Firdaus, Fitria Khairunnisa, Yanoar Pribadi Sarwono, Freddy Permana Zen. We investigate the holographic timelike entanglement entropy (HTEE) and timelike subregion complexity of a thermal CFT d deformed by a relevant scalar operator ϕ 0 \phi_{0} , dual to a hairy black hole in AdS d+1 .

pmc-11657140.description: BackgroundOne of the most challenging aspects of treating patients facing primary ovarian insufficiency, especially those eligible for controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (COH), is the assessment of ovarian function and response to stimulatory protocols in terms of the number of oocytes retrieved.

pmc-11714775.title: Understanding the Prescription Drug Costs among People with ADRD and Comorbidities: Evidence from Nationally Representative Datasets 2003‐2021
pmc-11714775.creator: Seyeon Jang, Rozalina G McCoy, Jie Chen
pmc-11714775.description: BackgroundEscalating drug costs are likely to disproportionately burden individuals with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) as they often have multiple chronic conditions (MCC). This study aimed to estimate the incremental total and out‐of‐pocket (OOP) drug costs associated with ADRD and MCC across the drug cost distributions.
